note: model_class: the online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file with the global RNG (the evaluator calls it after set_seed). This file records the fixed shape family of get_inputs as the machine-readable version of the task contract; tolerances and global-domain shape constraints are in task.yaml. Hidden/perf case inputs are generated deterministically by reference.py::make_inputs(**case) (consumption order inp1 -> weight1 -> res1).
